map.gist: EUR 12m over 7 years for a second UHT line. A parent guarantee is asked, the guarantor is not decided.

subjects.note: A group company is asked to guarantee the loan. Which one is not decided.

links.why: The teaser asks the parent to guarantee the loan.

facts.statement: Cedar Foods Ltd processes raw milk into UHT milk and yoghurt at its plant in Nakuru, Kenya.
facts.label: Legal name

facts.statement: Cedar Foods Ltd is an operating company with about 420 employees.
Cedar Foods is a dairy processor: an operating company in agribusiness that manufactures.
The borrower and its plant are in Kenya.
facts.label: Country

facts.statement: Cedar asks for a senior loan of EUR 12m over 7 years to add a second UHT line, with a guarantee from a group company that is not yet decided.
facts.label: Amount

answers.value: EUR 12m senior loan over 7 years for a second UHT line

facts.statement: The loan is asked in euros while all sales are in Kenya.
